title: When Should LLMs Reason? Adaptive Inference Routing via Entropy Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2605.22873v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning can improve LLM performance, but its benefits vary across tasks, models, and individual queries. On some tasks, CoT provides marginal or negative accuracy gains while substantially increasing token consumption. We investigate whether early decoding dynamics can help identify when explicit reasoning is useful. Our analysis shows that tasks with larger CoT gains tend to exhibit decreasing early-stage entropy, while low-gain tasks more often show oscillatory or increasing trajectories. These patterns motivate an empirical regime interpretation of decoding behavior. We propose \textbf{EDRM} (Entropy Dynamics-based Reasoning Manifold), a lightweight routing framework whose default heuristic requires no router training. translated_title: 大语言模型何时应该进行推理？基于熵动态的自适应推理路由
translated_abstract: 思维链推理可以提升大语言模型的性能，但其收益因任务、模型和具体查询而异。在某些任务上，CoT带来的准确率提升微乎其微甚至为负，同时却显著增加了token消耗。我们研究了早期解码动态是否有助于判断显式推理何时有用。我们的分析表明，CoT收益较大的任务往往在解码早期呈现熵值递减的趋势，而收益较低的任务则更多表现出振荡或上升的轨迹。这些模式促使我们对解码行为进行经验性状态解读。基于此，我们提出了EDRM（基于熵动态的推理流形），一个轻量级的路由框架，其默认启发式方法无需训练路由器。EDRM利用紧凑且可解释的表示来概括早期熵轨迹，并在直接解码、标准解码和CoT解码三种模式之间进行选择。在15个基准测试和7个大语言模型上的实验显示，其全局性能……
tldr: 提出无需训练的轻量级路由框架EDRM，通过解读解码早期的熵轨迹变化趋势，自适应地在直接、标准和思维链三种解码模式间选择，在15个基准和7个大语言模型上有效平衡准确率与token消耗。
en_tdlr: EDRM is a lightweight, training-free routing framework that leverages early decoding entropy dynamics to adaptively select among Direct, Standard, and CoT decoding, achieving better accuracy-efficiency trade-offs across 15 benchmarks and 7 LLMs.
